meta.purpose: Credits and links for photographers who contribute images to PSBP species pages. To add a contributor, append one object to the photographers array. 'id' is the slug used for the avatar file (images/photographers/<id>.webp) and must be unique. Leave inat or site as null if a person has no link of that kind; the page hides empty buttons and falls back to an initials tile when no avatar file exists.

photographers.name: Helen Lewis
photographers.blurb: Bradenton-area wildlife photographer with a focus on Florida's coastal birds — herons, owls, and roseate spoonbills among them.

photographers.name: Rob Carr
photographers.blurb: A prolific iNaturalist observer who has documented dozens of the park's plant and animal species.

photographers.name: Rhonda Olschefskie
photographers.blurb: Twenty-six photographs across twenty-three species, fourteen of them chosen as the lead image for their plant — the park's flowering collection largely as she has seen it, alongside herons at the pond edges.
